transcript.text: Hi everyone, I wanted to get us all together to talk about the family archive I'm putting together for Grandma's ninetieth birthday in October. As you probably know, we've got about 300 old 35mm negatives from decades of family gatherings and vacations, and I'd love to create a keepsake archive that could include a printed album, digital copies for everyone, and the original negatives preserved. Before I start selecting photos, ordering scans, or deciding how to share the digital copies, I want to check in with each of you about any personal requirements or photograph restrictions you might have. Are there any photos or events anyone would prefer not to include, or any specific photos you're hoping will make it into the archive?
